_doc: STAGING. Deepening, not a rebuild — the 9 shipped boards are carried through verbatim (merge-pack replaces wholesale, so the pack file must carry everything that survives) and 12 new ones are appended. Restores the board HEARTS took when it went to The Road Trip.

theme.name: The Cookout
theme.blurb: Somebody's cousin on the grill, matching shirts nobody agreed to, and a plate made for you before you asked.

boards.scene: What goes on the grate, and in what order

clues.breast: Goes on last because it dries out first, whatever your uncle says
clues.brats: The ones that get eaten standing up before the plates come out
clues.baste: Every turn, with the sauce that has been on the side burner since noon
clues.sear: Hot side first, then moved — the whole method in four words
clues.rest: Off the heat, under foil, and hands off
clues.tea: The jug again, and somebody has already gone for more ice

boards.scene: The card table under the tree

clues.phased: What nobody at this table gets, no matter what you lead with
clues.spade: The suit that decides it, and the reason two grown people are standing up
clues.shade: Both the tree and the conversation, and the tree is the lesser one
clues.heap: How a plate is built when your auntie builds it for you
clues.head: What the argument is about by round three, and it is not the cards
clues.ash: Flicked off the end of a cigarette nobody admits to having

boards.scene: Who runs the grill, and what happens if you touch it

clues.turban: The wrap on her head that says she has been up since six
clues.aunt: Holds the tongs. Has held the tongs since 1994. Will hold the tongs
clues.rub: Went on last night, which is the part that makes it hers
clues.turn: Once. Anyone who does it twice is asked to sit down
clues.burnt: The edge some people ask for on purpose, and they are correct
clues.bran: In the muffins nobody came for, brought by the cousin who tries

boards.scene: The table, not the grill

clues.cinema: What the yard becomes once the sun drops and the speaker gets louder
clues.mac: Baked, with the crust, and there is exactly one person allowed to bring it
clues.ice: Ran out at four. Somebody is already in the car
clues.can: Buried to the elbow in the cooler, and the cold water is the good part
clues.amen: Said fast by whoever is nearest, because the food is going cold
clues.acme: The peak of the afternoon, roughly twenty minutes after the plates

boards.scene: The extension cord and everything running off it

clues.candor: What the aux cord produces within one hour, from someone's nephew
clues.corn: In the husk, straight on the grate, and the silk burns off
clues.cord: Orange, running from the kitchen window to the speaker, taped down badly
clues.can: Handed to you without being asked for, which is how you know you are family
clues.card: The table by the fence, and the reason nobody helps carry anything
clues.arc: The one the horseshoe makes before it misses

boards.scene: After the plates, before the dark

clues.sliced: How the melon arrives, on the good tray, from the trunk of a car
clues.slide: Starts when the right song comes on, and the aunties know it first
clues.ice: Second run of the day, and this time somebody went with them
clues.dice: Come out once the kids are inside and the grown folks are grown
clues.lid: Back on the cooler, which is the first sign it is winding down
clues.deli: Where the potato salad came from, a fact being actively denied

boards.scene: The dessert table, which is a folding table

clues.backer: Every dish here has one, and they are standing near it watching you
clues.cake: Pound. Under a dome. Not to be touched until it is announced
clues.bake: What she did at eleven at night so it would sit right by two
clues.rack: Cooling on it by the window since this morning
clues.beak: What the one bold bird has been eyeing since the foil came off
clues.acre: How far the smell has carried, roughly, by four in the afternoon

boards.scene: The cooler, the dip, and the folding chairs

clues.depict: What the group photo fails to do, every single year
clues.dip: In the bowl with the lid that does not match, and it goes first
clues.pit: Dug once, years ago, and still where the whole thing happens
clues.ice: The third bag. Nobody planned for the third bag
clues.tide: How the chairs drift toward the shade over the course of an afternoon
clues.diet: Announced on Monday by at least two people here

boards.scene: Working out how you are related

clues.asking: What the first ten minutes are, in both directions, at every table
clues.kin: The word on the banner, and the definition is deliberately generous
clues.sing: What the elders do after the food, unaccompanied, and everyone stands
clues.king: What the oldest man present is treated as for one afternoon a year
clues.gain: Two this year, in the babies, announced before anybody eats
clues.skin: Whose you have, decided loudly by an aunt within a minute of meeting you

boards.scene: The ribs, and who is allowed an opinion

clues.brides: Two of them here today, neither married yet, both being asked when
clues.ribs: On since eight, and the person who put them on has not sat down since
clues.bid: Made for the end piece, out loud, an hour before anything is ready
clues.side: Argued about more seriously than the meat, every single year
clues.bride: Cousin who is not one yet and has been asked four times before two o'clock
clues.rides: Worked out at the end, badly, with three people going the same way

boards.scene: The pot on the side burner

clues.corned: The beef somebody's people put in the greens, and it is not up for debate
clues.corn: In the husk, straight on the grate, turned with a bare hand and a fast wrist
clues.cord: Orange, running from the kitchen window to the speaker, taped to the step
clues.done: Said about the meat by someone who is not the one who decides that
clues.code: Nobody explained about which cooler is which, and everybody follows it
clues.cone: Of the yard where the pot lives, out of the wind, where it always is

boards.scene: Getting it lit

clues.sparky: The lighter that works if you hold it at the angle only one person knows
clues.spark: Off the chimney starter, caught on the wind, and everybody steps back
clues.park: Where this would be if the yard had not been claimed by April
clues.pray: Over the food, and the length of it is a whole conversation afterwards
clues.spar: Over the domino score, in a way that is not actually an argument
clues.rays: Coming level across the yard, which is when the chairs get moved

boards.scene: The chairs, and where you are allowed to sit

clues.creaky: The good chair, which is the bad chair, and it goes to whoever arrives last
clues.rack: Lifted off with two towels because the mitt is somewhere in the house
clues.year: Since the last one, and the count is done out loud at the table
clues.acre: What the yard is not, and the number of people here does not care
clues.race: Of the children to the cooler the second the lid is lifted
clues.cake: Brought by the one person whose gets eaten first, every year

boards.scene: The kitchen, which is a second cookout

clues.baking: Going on inside while the grill goes on outside, and the two do not speak
clues.bag: Of ice, third one, and the person sent for it has not come back
clues.kin: Everybody here, by a route that takes four minutes to explain
clues.king: Of the kitchen, and the title is not shared and never has been
clues.gain: On the plate the second you look away from it
clues.bank: On her to bring it, and the trust has never once been misplaced

boards.scene: The catching-up, done standing

clues.births: Three since last year, and all three are being passed around right now
clues.ribs: Handed over on a paper plate that is already going soft
clues.shirt: Changed after the grill, because the smoke got into the first one
clues.bits: Of the end piece, given away, which is how you know who is favoured
clues.birth: Being retold at the table by everyone except the person it happened to
clues.stir: The pot on the side burner, by whoever is passing, without being asked

boards.scene: The cousins, and what they get away with

clues.pranks: Run on the youngest, by the second youngest, in the same order as always
clues.park: Across the road, where they get sent when the volume gets decided
clues.spark: In the eye of the one who is about to start something
clues.snap: Of the towel, once, and then the rule about it gets restated
clues.pans: Stacked by the sink by whoever is quietly doing the actual work
clues.rank: Worked out among the cousins by age, and enforced without anybody saying it

boards.scene: The music, and the volume argument

clues.sawing: What the speaker is doing to the song at the volume it is set to
clues.sing: Everyone, on the one song, and nobody has agreed to it in advance
clues.wings: Gone in eleven minutes, and the plate is not replaced
clues.gain: Turned up by somebody who then walks away from the phone
clues.swig: From the wrong cup, discovered a second too late
clues.wins: The argument about the volume, for about ninety seconds

boards.scene: The dip, and its defenders

clues.podium: Where the person who made the dip is standing, spiritually
clues.dip: Guarded, at the near end, by the one who knows what went into it
clues.mop: Fetched for the spill before anybody has finished apologising for it
clues.mud: By the tap where the children have been running, since about one o'clock
clues.dump: What you do not do to the last of it, and there are rules about this
clues.dim: The corner of the yard by six, which is when the citronella comes out

boards.scene: Packing the cooler, which is a skill

clues.builds: The cooler in layers, and will explain the layers to anyone who asks
clues.bid: For the last cold one, put in early, honoured later
clues.bus: Stop where somebody's people are walking from, and a car goes anyway
clues.lid: Left up for four seconds too long, and it gets mentioned
clues.slid: The chair back on the concrete, which is the sound of somebody giving up
clues.buds: On the branch over the fence, and somebody says it is going to rain

boards.scene: The aunts, and the greeting line

clues.naught: What you say you want, and a plate is made for you regardless
clues.aunt: Greeted first, by name, before you put anything down anywhere
clues.hug: Not optional, and the length of it is not yours to decide
clues.tag: Played around the legs of people who are trying to hold plates
clues.haunt: The corner of the yard the older ones keep, out of the sun, all day
clues.gnat: Around the light over the back door from about eight

boards.scene: The macaroni, and who is trusted with it

clues.carmen: Whose dish it is, and the name is said before the dish is
clues.mac: The one that matters, and there is only one that counts as the one
clues.amen: Said at the end, by everybody, a half-beat after it was expected
clues.can: Bring a dish next year, and the answer to that is carefully worded
clues.name: On the bottom of the pan in marker, because it is going home tonight
clues.cream: In it, which is the part that is never fully admitted to
